items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: oh, we had Billy Ward and the Dominoes, and a lesser-known other group.

ctx.x: And he was the butt of all the jokes?

Yeah, or maybe it was the other way around. Sugar Ray was the butt of all the jokes, and Scotty was the funny man. We had some vocal quartets like -- I call them “bird groups.” Not the Orioles. Not someone that big in stature, but -- oh, we had Billy Ward and the Dominoes, and a lesser-known other group. This tour took us all down through the South: Macon, Georgia; Raleigh, North Carolina; Charlotte, North Carolina;, Atlanta; Richmond, Virginia; Dallas, Texas. I can remember in Texas -- now this, I’m talking…
